BiblicalUsage: Ithra is named once, in 2 Samuel 17:25. In 2 Samuel 17:25 we read, "And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son..."
TheologicalSignificance: Ithra teaches me that faithfulness does not need fame to be recorded.
